base.initialization_source: same SHA-verified per-fold Experiment 43.1/E61 anchor parameters; each seed replays ten-epoch E62-E2 warmup from epoch 1

seed_protocol.seed_zero_compatibility: requested seed 0 reproduces the E61 fold construction RNG; E62-E2 remains a read-only reference
seed_protocol.parameter_initialization: all trainable model parameters still load from the same per-fold historical anchor; requested seed changes the construction/training RNG stream used from epoch 1, including dropout
seed_protocol.pair_sampling: same fixed per-fold pair cache as E62-E2; no seed-dependent resampling

optimization.best_checkpoint: strict ACC improvement under historical val=test protocol

protocol_limits: Only the requested training RNG seed changes; E62-E2 architecture, optimizer settings, losses, gates, data, fixed folds, pair cache, and stopping/checkpoint rules are unchanged.
The five seed groups each independently replay ten warmup epochs from the same per-fold untrained anchor; E62-E2 best checkpoints and seed-0 warmups are read-only references.
Historical val=test checkpoint selection, pre-CV preprocessing, and the transductive 871-node graph are retained.
Single-run seeds and overlapping outer folds provide descriptive robustness evidence, not independent external validation.
